name: The Chess Club
description: Regulars at the chess club each swear by a different opening, a favourite tactic, and a prized set. Work out who plays what.
clues: Judit, Zugzwang, and Walnut belong to different players.
Judit goes with exactly one of Skewer, Zugzwang, or Walnut.
Discovery goes with either Nadia or Maple (but not both).
Pin goes with at least one of Nadia, Ebony, or Pewter.
Mikhail, Zugzwang, and Rosewood belong to different players.
Walnut goes with at least one of Mikhail or Pin.
Pin goes with neither Boris nor Judit.
